stem: Pihu starts with vinegar that turns blue litmus red. She adds baking soda solution a little at a time until the mixture is neither acidic nor basic, and the tube feels slightly warm.

statements.text: Enough baking soda solution mixed with the vinegar can make a solution that is neither acidic nor basic.
One drop of baking soda solution is enough to neutralise any amount of vinegar.
Heat can be produced when enough acid and base are mixed in this way.

teacher.key_rationale: Neutralisation needs enough acid and base and can produce heat. One drop is not enough for any amount of vinegar.
